items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: it was during the time I had Art Pepper, Jack MacVay and Luke Jones was playing saxaphones at the Club Alabam

ctx.x: No, I forgot about it -- but it was when after he was out here and he just had his trio, but that's when I had -- it was during the time I had Art Pepper, Jack MacVay and Luke Jones was playing saxaphones at the Club Alabam, and a trumpet player named Chiefie, and I guess it was Dudley.
But I don't know what time that was, because Art Pepper was very young, and you know Art Pepper, right?
